messages:
alex: Heads-up: deploybot just flagged the build for rc-2026.03. We have an SBOM provenance mismatch for the NVIDIA driver blob included in the dedicated image :grimacing:

 deploy-bot: AUTOMATION: Release rc-2026.03 failed SBOM provenance check
 - artifact: images/redwood/dedicated-gpu:rc-2026.03
 - diff: driver_blob_v2.1.7 -> driver_blob_v2.2.0
 - evidence: missing cosign sig for layer sha256:abcd1234
 - action: canary quarantined

 priya: Ugh. Is this the same vendor recipe change we saw last quarter? Any PGP/cosign receipts in the repo? Can we fall back to the prior driver in the image?

 maria: I checked CI: earlier image with driver_blob_v2.1.7 exists at digest sha256:1111aaaa. Quick option: revert bump in the image build and re-run the release pipeline.

 release-engineer: Reverting is fine but we need a fast plan for Dedicated customers on reserved pools. Re-deploying images will cause a ~2h window. We should decide: hotfix commit + targeted canary or pause full rollout.

 legal: License check: vendor attached a new EULA snippet with v2.2.0 that requires attribution for redistributions. That's a change we can't silently ship to enterprise customers. We need either vendor attestation or remove the blob.

 sam: For immediate mitigation: can we carve out Dedicated and send rc-2026.03 without the driver to hosted API? Hosted doesn't include the driver blob.

 alex: status: canary is blocked per deploy-bot. I propose: 1) revert driver bump in image, 2) emit release note explaining delayed dedicated rollout, 3) file vendor evidence request to ops-vendor@ tomorrow, 4) schedule a 24h timebox. Thoughts?

 priya: +1 to revert. Also add a CI gate: `scripts/verify-sbom.sh` should fail on unsigned layers. Patch ready: `git revert -m 1 <commit>`

 deploy-bot: NOTE: Canary quarantined: region-us-west-2. Manual unquarantine allowed after new image pushed and SBOM revalidated.

 maria: I'll cut the rollback PR and kick off a new pipeline. PR link: https://github.com/redwood/release/pull/4821

 legal: Please include the EULA text from vendor in the ticket. We'll advise customers if needed.

 release-engineer: Plan agreed. Timebox 24h. If vendor doesn't provide provenance or clears EULA, we'll remove the driver blob from dedicated images and proceed with hosted rollout. Sam, can you draft release notes language?

 sam: Drafting now. Will post short blurb and link to the vendor ticket.

 alex: thanks. I'll ping infra to prioritize the revert rollout. :thumbsup:

 maria: new pipeline started, will update thread when canary passes.

 deploy-bot: BUILD: rc-2026.03-revert started (pipeline 8912)

 maria: update: canary still quarantined, awaiting SBOM revalidation step. If it passes -> unquarantine and proceed with limited Dedicated rollout.

 priya: FYI adding `--require-signed-layers` flag to image build to prevent recurrence.

 legal: filing customer advisory draft. assign me for review before we publish.

 alex: End state: temporary dedicated carveout + rollback PR in flight. Follow-up meeting scheduled in 2h. Closing thread for now, will re-open with pipeline status.
